description_en: Add labels to a custom person library or a person
description_zh: 给⾃定义⼈物库或⼈物贴标签
kebab_example: aliyun mts tag-custom-person --category-id CategoryId001-0000 --category-name CategoryNametest-0000 --category-description CategoryDescription001-0000 --person-id PersonId001-0000 --person-name PersonNametest-0000 --person-description PersonDescriptiontest-0000 --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagCustomPerson

parameters.help_en:
Person library ID. This ID uniquely identifies a custom person library. It is generated by the caller, who must ensure its uniqueness.

Note: This ID must not be the same as any system person library ID. If it matches a system ID, the system person library will be used by default. The ID can contain up to 120 characters, supports both Chinese and English characters, and is case-insensitive. You can query this using the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html API
parameters.help_zh:
⼈物库ID。⽤于唯⼀标识⼀个⾃定义⼈物库，由调⽤者⽣成，调⽤者⾃⼰保证唯⼀性。

注意不能与系统⼈物库ID相同 ，如相同则默认使用系统人物库。最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写。可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html接口查询
